# Setup

## Load libraries and dataset
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(jtools)
library(psych)
library(EFAtools)
library(lavaan)
df_subset <- haven::read_dta("hsls_subset_long.dta") # can use numeric values
df_analysis <- df_subset %>% haven::as_factor() #make it factors
```
# Reliability and Validity

## Subset Parent Questions for pa Year
```{r}
psd <- df_subset %>% dplyr::select(s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks)
phbae <- df_subset %>% dplyr::select(par_exp1, par_asp1, able_ba1)
home <- df_subset %>% dplyr::select(par_exp1, par_asp1, able_ba1, s1momtalkm, s1dadtalkm, s1momtalks, s1dadtalks)

```

## Reliability
```{r}
psych::alpha(psd)
psych::alpha(phbae)
psych::alpha(home)

```

#  Linear Regression
```{r}

lm <- lm(data = df_analysis,
 math_cred ~ # do this by semester since there are half credits
    psd_scale + phbae_scale + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
    x1race + ses + female + # ses/demographics
    as.numeric(math_level) + math_score + # prior achievement
    scale_math_eff + scale_math_uti + scale_math_int + scale_math_id + # affect
    time*as.numeric(math_level) +
    urban + public) # school level


lm %>% tbl_regression()

```

#  Poisson Regression
```{r}

poi <- glm(data = df_analysis,
 2*math_cred ~ # do this by semester since there are half credits
    psd_scale + phbae_scale + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
    x1race + ses + female + # ses/demographics
    as.numeric(math_level) + math_score + # prior achievement
    scale_math_eff + scale_math_uti + scale_math_int + scale_math_id + # affect
    urban + public,# school level
 family = poisson) 


summ(poi)

```

# Logistic Regressin
```{r}
glm <- glm(data = df_analysis,
           math_cred4 ~ 
             psd_scale + phbae_scale + par_sch_inv + # parent factors
             x1race + ses + female + # ses/demographics
             middle_math + math_score + # prior achievement
             scale_math_eff + scale_math_uti + scale_math_int + scale_math_id + # affect
             public, public, # school level
           weights = NULL,
           family = binomial)


summ(glm, exp = TRUE)

```
